title: Summary: Ignoring Files
objective: Write a .gitignore with two rules, create the files they cover, and print the status and the result of check-ignore.
hint: Set-Content for .gitignore with @("*.log", "secrets.txt") as the value. Then Set-Content for app.log, secrets.txt, and README.md. Then Write-Output with (git status --short), and again with (git check-ignore app.log).
